title: Robot vacuum
prompt: a round robot vacuum: press clean, it drives off its dock, bumps a wall, turns, picks up dust, returns to dock; see-through shows the lidar, bumper switches, drive motors, brush roll, suction fan, bin and battery
blurb: Press Clean and watch a lidar robot leave its dock, bump into the wall and sweep up the dust, then turn on See-through to see the spinning laser, bumper switches, brushes, fan and battery doing it.
